notes.title: Update Patch - v.1.5 + Achievements working
notes.notes:
- Minor gameplay issues fixed.

- Good Ending now can be got by getting at least 20 notes, so it more easy to do this and unlock the achievement.

I'm very happy to let know everyone that achievements now are working but from now only available for Windows.
MAC & Linux are still absent to this feature from NWjs

Enjoy this update!

notes.title: Update Patch - v.1.1.2
notes.notes:
27/11/2015 

- Major Change: You will see "checked" at the end of the notes name, so you don't have to read two times at least if it is not to solve a puzzle!
- Minnor Change: I've did some improvements in designs that will improve the player experience.
- Bugfix: Some objects are duplicated when you leave and start a new game.
- Minor Bugfix: You could enter to apartment 203 from the door of 204.

Enjoy this update! ːsteamsadː

notes.title: Update - v.1.0.8
notes.notes:
24/11/2015

- Major Change: Now is playable for anyone
- Add: You can use Mouse now
- Add: More tutorials and "tips" for be easy playable
- Bugfix: Could take infinite items using "G" key
- Bugfix: You could stop your enemy open the notes menu
- Bugfix: "Tips" was showing always: "No tips for now"
- Minnor bugs fixed too

Enjoy this update! ːsteamhappyː
